summary: OpenAI reaffirms its Zero Data Retention option for eligible API customers and previews a new Private Safety Processing feature intended to enable AI safety processing without compromising data privacy.

practices.reason: Data retention terms affect what API customers must configure or verify for compliance, though this reaffirms an existing option rather than introducing a change.
practices.quote: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.
